analysis.reasonEn:
RSI rose from 41.0 to 53.3, confirming exit from oversold territory.
MACD histogram also improved from -1.7667 to 2.2627, signaling an upward turn.
The buy signal has been maintained for the past 3 consecutive sessions, forming a Higher Low pattern.
Current price $532.00 is below SMA50 $535.44 but above EMA50 $528.06, confirming mid-term trend support.
